name: feedback_id
description: Primary key. One row per review.

name: business_id
description: Stable identifier of the reviewed business. STR-nnn joins to AlloyDB stores.store_id; CMP-nnn is a competitor with no operational record. Join on this, never on business_name.

name: business_name
description: Display name of the reviewed business. Presentation only: not unique and not stable.

name: business_type
description: Either 'own_store' or 'competitor'. Filter on this before drawing any conclusion about this brand.

name: zip_code
description: ZIP of the reviewed business. Joins to demographics_and_traffic.zip_code.

name: rating
description: Star rating, 1-5. Consistent with the sentiment of review_text.

name: review_date
description: Date the review was posted, within 180 days of the scenario anchor date.

name: review_text
description: Review prose, written by AI.GENERATE at provision time from a tone and topic label. Wording differs between projects; the sentiment it encodes does not.
